name: Mike Ma
description: Mike Ma is the Founder and Managing Partner at Sidecut Ventures, a pre-seed venture fund that backs “coachable superheroes” — founders tackling systemic challenges in economic mobility, digital health, climate, and education. Sidecut takes a “coach first, capital second” approach, combining investment with hands-on operational support and mentorship.
